name: Japhlet
title: Descendant of Asher
summary: Japhlet was a son of Heber and a descendant of the tribe of Asher. He is mentioned in 1 Chronicles in connection with the genealogies of Asher's descendants, who were known as skilled warriors and family leaders.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogy of Asher
keyEvents.description: Jaflet is listed as a son of Heber in the genealogy of the tribe of Asher, as part of Israel's historical genealogies.

keyEvents.title: The sons of Jaflet
keyEvents.description: Jaflet's sons Pasak, Bimhal, and Asjvat are named as his descendants in 1 Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: The tribe of Asher as skilled warriors
keyEvents.description: The descendants of Asher, including the lineage of Jaflet, were described as heads of families, skilled warriors, and prominent leaders. They were mustered for military service.

keyEvents.title: Part of Heber's family
keyEvents.description: Jaflet belonged to the family of Heber, who was a prominent clan leader among the descendants of Asher in Israel.
